en: Old black‑and‑white postcard image of a small brick railway station building labeled "Taxinge‑Näsby" on its facade. The station has a gabled roof and decorative brickwork, with a covered porch on the right side. Several people, including railway staff in uniform and civilians, stand on the platform in front of the station. A semaphore railway signal stands near the tracks, and there is a wooded area and low hill behind the station. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the card.
